acceptanceCriteria.text: `sourceSha256` is produced from the exact resolved Route 2 build source using the same NAR-hash semantics consumed by bootstrap/runtime verification.
The npm tarball digest remains represented separately and is never substituted for source NAR identity.
A regression test feeds a production-shaped generated descriptor into the real source-resolution boundary and proves the source integrity check passes for the intended release.
A deliberately mismatched source NAR hash fails closed with the existing bounded integrity diagnostic.
Existing descriptor schema/identity validation remains green.

issue.title: fix: publish the canonical source NAR hash in deployment descriptors
